author: kai
text: morning all — reviewing the launch checklist for tomorrow. who owns the marketing site update?

author: sasha
text: that's me. i'll push the new hero copy + screenshots by 4pm today.

author: kai
text: great. and the changelog post — me or you, mike?

author: mike
text: i'll take the changelog. due end of day tomorrow before we go live.

author: amira
text: can someone double-check stripe is in live mode in production env vars? i tested staging yesterday and webhook secret was test-mode.

author: mike
text: i'll check the env vars today. not tomorrow — today.

author: sasha
text: also reminder: legal needs to sign off on the ToS update before launch. did anyone hear back from them?

author: kai
text: i pinged sara from legal yesterday, no reply. i'll follow up this afternoon.

author: amira
text: we should also have someone monitoring during the rollout window.

author: amira
text: i can take the 10am-12pm slot tomorrow.

author: mike
text: i can take 12-2pm.

author: kai
text: i'll do 2pm-4pm. sasha?

author: sasha
text: i've got a customer call at 4 — but i can do 4-6pm if we push the call.

author: kai
text: let's say sasha 4-6 contingent on the call moving.

author: amira
text: btw the staging deploy is broken right now, npm install fails on the lockfile. kai when you're free can you take a look?

author: kai
text: ugh ok i'll look at the lockfile this morning.

author: sasha
text: love this. lunch tomorrow on me if launch goes smooth.

author: mike
text: ha. won't say no.

author: amira
text: what time is the post-launch retro? wednesday?

author: kai
text: wednesday 10am. i'll send a cal invite.
